items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: the fella that was our tutor putting us on the stage in Louisville... His name was Billy Maxey... I give Maxey some money to buy food for him and his wife.

ctx.x: When we got to Chicago, a fellow that we used to work for, they had us there, called William Poe, P-O-E. William Poe and he was a meat man, he handled meat and he took us to Chicago from Indianapolis and when we got to Chicago that's when we played the O'Clean Theater and he ran off with the money and we are all stranded there and the fella that was our tutor putting us on the stage in Louisville, he had his wife along with him and he was taking care of us. His name was Billy Maxey. He was a comedian, Billy Maxey…

fella, the manager of the theater in Louisville, had to dress us all, we first went on as urchins in the theater and I was just with his sister before she died. She was in Chicago and he went to New York and I saw him in New York since I've been grown and I met his sister and I only learned about her when he passed, 'cause she got in touch with me to let me know he passed and so forth and I found out when I got in touch with her she moved to Chicago from New York and in Chicago I went to see her. I got pictures…
